versions.changelog:
ratsinfo-de v1.2.0

- Adds comprehensive usage documentation for querying German municipal council records via OParl.
- Explains all major commands, their suitable scenarios, and example usages.
- Details skill limitations (e.g. no extraction of construction costs or tender info).
- Specifies privacy, caching, and network access behavior.
- Offers clear guidance on finding endpoints, checking health, tracking council papers, and generating reports.
- No code dependencies beyond the Python standard library; no local files modified aside from cache and optional iCal/PDF output.
